info.title: PersonalHub API
info.description: Single-user GitHub and Notion read integration. Send the PersonalHub API key, not upstream tokens. Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json. Dates are ISO-8601; pagination returns arrays.

get.summary: Read the cached GitHub and Notion overview
get.description: Reads PostgreSQL only, using a repeatable-read transaction. Never calls upstream or triggers sync. Notion disabled returns enabled=false, zero counts and null checkpoint/history. Status counts exclude archived tasks and preserve null/unassigned status. Latest runs can be FAILED; generatedAt is response generation time, not source freshness.

parameters.description: Rolling GitHub commit window; Notion counts cover the whole configured source cache.

post.description: Runs inside the request. A failure returns ApiProblem with syncRunId, not a NotionSyncRun body. Read /api/v1/notion/sync-runs/{syncRunId} for the persisted FAILED run and safe errorMessage. PostgreSQL advisory locking prevents concurrent syncs for the same data source.
